name: digger
title: Digger
description: Like dig but for the web. Comprehensive website intelligence and metadata extraction.
author: chrismessina

preferences.name: acceptLanguage
preferences.title: Page Language
preferences.description: Request content using a BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en-US).

preferences.name: prettyPrintCode
preferences.title: Code Formatting
preferences.label: Pretty-print JSON and XML when viewing a file
preferences.description: Re-indent minified files so they are readable. Turn off to see exactly the bytes the server sent — Copy and Download always use the original either way.

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.description: Show detailed logs in the console for debugging.
preferences.label: Enable extra diagnostics in the console

preferences.name: strictRedaction
preferences.title: Strict Redaction
preferences.description: Turn on before reproducing an issue, then share only the new lines.
preferences.label: Also hide URL query strings and fragments in logs

commands.name: digger
commands.title: Digger
commands.description: Get comprehensive website intelligence and metadata

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromSelectedText
preferences.title: Empty URL Fallback
preferences.description: When no URL is typed, dig the URL in the selected text.
preferences.label: Use Selected Text

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromClipboard
preferences.description: When no URL is typed or selected, dig the URL on the clipboard.
preferences.label: Use Clipboard

preferences.name: enableBrowserExtensionSupport
preferences.description: Last fallback: the active browser tab. macOS only; needs the browser extension.
preferences.label: Use Current Browser Tab

commands.name: open-current-tab
commands.title: Open Current Tab in Digger
commands.subtitle: Digger
commands.description: Dig the website in the active browser tab (macOS, needs the browser extension)

commands.name: open-clipboard
commands.title: Open Clipboard in Digger
commands.subtitle: Digger
commands.description: Dig the URL on the clipboard

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
